meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only for external windows or desktop UI that needs OS-level control, and Playwright or CDP for external pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从命令行调度开发工作区,完成智能体间的任务交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你同时跑多个开发智能体,需要在工作区、终端和任务间来回切换。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate dev worktrees and hand off tasks between agents from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple dev agents and need to switch between their worktrees, terminals, and ongoing tasks.

howto.what: 装好后,一旦涉及 Orca 管理的内容,Claude 会使用 `orca` 命令来操作代码工作区、终端、仓库、自动化、产物、技能共享和内置浏览器;执行前会先选定正确的 Orca 程序,再读取对应版本的用法说明。
howto.when: 当用户提到“$orca-cli”、“Orca worktree”等关键词,或要求处理与 Orca 状态相关的事务,如在 worktree 里启动代理、操作 Orca 终端、把任务交接给其他代理等时触发。

say.text: 列出目前所有的 Orca worktree,并说明各自的状态。
在第三个 worktree 里打开一个终端,并运行 npm test。
say.note: 这会为该 worktree 开启绑定终端并执行命令。

say.text: 把当前任务通过 Orca 的 handoff 交接给另一个 agent。

howto.what_en: When Orca state is involved, Claude uses the `orca` CLI to manage Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, and embedded browser. It first resolves the correct Orca executable and loads the version-matched guide before running commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions phrases like "$orca-cli" or "Orca worktree", or asks for anything involving Orca-managed state, e.g. running an agent in a worktree, operating an Orca terminal, or handing a task to another agent.

say_en.text: List all current Orca worktrees and describe their statuses.
say_en.note: This runs the Orca CLI worktree listing/status command.

say_en.text: Open a terminal pinned to worktree #3 and run npm test.
say_en.note: This creates a worktree-bound terminal and runs the command.

say_en.text: Hand off the current task to another agent via Orca's handoff.
say_en.note: Claude passes the task to another agent using the handoff mechanism.
